q: The KL divergence (relative entropy) D_KL(P||Q) = ∑P(x)log(P(x)/Q(x)) satisfies:
opts: D_KL(P||Q) ≥ 0 with equality iff P=Q (Gibbs' inequality)
exp: By Jensen's inequality (log is concave): D_KL(P||Q) = -∑P log(Q/P) ≥ -log∑P(Q/P) = -log 1 = 0. Equality iff Q/P is constant a.e., i.e., P=Q. KL divergence is not symmetric — it is not a metric.
